scripts.build: npm run build:sdk && npm run build --prefix ui
scripts.test: npm run build:sdk && npm run test:server && npm run test:cli
scripts.setup: npm ci && npm ci --prefix server && npm ci --prefix ui && npm ci --prefix browser
scripts.build:sdk: npm run build --workspace=@oya-ai/browser && npm run build --workspace=@oya-ai/cli
scripts.test:server: cd server && for t in test-flow-recorder test-playbook-cleanup test-control-lock test-desktop-control test-durable-control test-control-api test-control-worker test-control-cluster test-security test-pool test-sandbox test-cdp test-mcp-lifecycle test-control-plane test-providers test-provider-flow test-persona-persistence test-gateway test-anonymity test-challenges test-login-flow test-control-pg-client test-fleet-k8s test-key-storage test-slack; do node $t.js || exit 1; done
scripts.test:cli: npm run build --workspace=@oya-ai/cli && node packages/cli/test-prompt.mjs && node packages/cli/test-install.mjs
